verdict.rationale: Gladia is an API product, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions. The evidence pack shows no versioned API scheme and no documented deprecation policy. Selecting a named model via the `model` parameter (default solaria-1) is model choice, an adjacent feature, not API versioning or a deprecation commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
